name: Chapter 1: Solutions
description: Concentration units, Henry’s and Raoult’s laws, ideal and non-ideal solutions, azeotropes, colligative properties, van’t Hoff factor

name: Chapter 2: Electrochemistry
description: Galvanic cells, electrode potentials, Nernst equation, Gibbs energy, conductivity, Kohlrausch law, electrolysis, batteries, fuel cells, corrosion

name: Chapter 3: Chemical Kinetics
description: Reaction rates, rate law, order and molecularity, zero and first order integrated laws, half-life, Arrhenius equation, catalysts, collision theory

name: Chapter 4: The d- and f-Block Elements
description: Transition metal trends, oxidation states, E° values, magnetism, colour, catalysis, K₂Cr₂O₇, KMnO₄, lanthanoids and actinoids

name: Chapter 5: Coordination Compounds
description: Werner’s theory, ligands and terms, IUPAC names, isomerism, VBT, crystal field splitting, colour, metal carbonyls and applications

name: Biomolecules (Chemistry)
description: Corrected Chemistry Biomolecules flashcards covering carbohydrates, proteins, enzymes, vitamins, and hormones.
